releaseNotes: CRITICAL FIX: Removed persistent per-USB PowerShell FileSystemWatcher processes
Added bounded Node-based USB file monitoring with polling fallback
Added overlap guards for recurring scans and health checks
Fixed installer update path to preserve existing SQL registry settings
Fixed DLP configuration parsing so disabled monitor flags are respected
Fixed web upload and Outlook webmail scanning when the service runs as LocalSystem
Added likely original filename correlation for browser temporary upload files

fixed: Persistent USB PowerShell watcher sessions replaced with Node file watchers
Service startup retry no longer stacks duplicate monitor intervals
DLP configuration booleans now preserve false/0 values
Installer update no longer clears SQL registry settings when SQL parameters are omitted
Web upload scanning now enumerates real user profiles instead of the LocalSystem profile
Temporary browser upload files now attempt to correlate to the likely original user file
added: Polling fallback for USB file monitoring
Tracked child processes for email/web PowerShell scans
Profile-aware Downloads/Desktop/Documents/temp scanning for browser upload detection
improved: Timeout and overlap handling for recurring process-based scans
Shutdown cleanup for tracked monitor intervals and child processes
Release manifest aligned with installer root executable URL
Possible web upload classification when an email browser is active and recent user files are detected

updateInstructions: Existing SQL registry settings are preserved when update parameters are omitted
Critical updates are published by replacing enhanced_audit_service.exe and version.json in the release repository
